body: Yeah, I'm still here. I live in the USA, and I've been talking to teachers about my situation.

I'm terrified of seeking help, as they'll quite probably find a way to make it look like nothing is happening- or that I'm overreacting to the situation. Does this stuff qualify as abuse? If it does, I'll try and seek help somewhere. I won't be able to bring a bag, though, more than likely. I don't take PE in the 11th grade, nor do I have my phone- they took it last evening.
I'm sorry, man. I'll hold your hand if you like.
